claims.claim: CME and Silicon Data announced H100 and B200 rental-index futures with a planned Oct 5 2026 start; as of Oct 21 regulators had not cleared the market and CME's calendar listed Nov 9 as first trading day.
ICE and Ornn announced cash-settled GPU compute futures on the Ornn index (OCPI) for H100, H200, B200 and RTX 5090, subject to regulatory approval, with no listing date.
CoreWeave Q2 2026: Customer A 36%, Customer B 26%, Customer C 10% of revenue; 98% of revenue commitment-linked; RPO $103.7B.
Silicon Data March 2026: hyperscaler H100 about $7.43-7.52/hr vs neocloud $2.43-2.63, roughly 3x.
SemiAnalysis 1-year H100 contract index rose from $1.70 (Oct 2025) to $2.35 (Mar 2026); posted prices are directional only.
Silicon Data neocloud H100 index was $2.90/GPU-hour on 2026-10-29.
Nebius raised H100 on-demand from $3.85 to $4.50 per GPU-hour effective about Oct 1 2026.
Akash reported GPU utilization about 33.7% in Q1 2026 with lease revenue $253,250.
Enron Broadband: 759 bandwidth transactions in Q2 2001 vs 580 in Q1; lost $102M on $16M revenue; Skilling said there were no creditworthy counterparties.
Pantera's Sept 2026 report says cash-settled compute exchanges have not large trading volumes yet and participants are likely OTC desks and brokers.
Vast.ai on-demand H100 SXM ask prices on 2026-10-29 ranged from $1.93 to $5.56 per GPU-hour with median $2.40 across 13 offers.
SF Compute founder says about 5% of capacity trades on its order book.
